battle.name: 唐破吐蕃維州之戰
battle.brief: 貞元十八年（802）正月，吐蕃大相論莽熱率十萬援軍南下解維州之圍，唐劍南西川節度使韋皋以西川兵萬餘預先設伏於維州薛城一帶險道，唐兵出挑戰引敵追入谷中，伏兵合擊，論莽熱被擒，援軍死傷大半。卡面的投石機為扭力式拋石機，與唐軍砲車同出一脈，攻城與封鎖谷道皆用其石彈。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐與吐蕃在西線邊境的一次決戰，交手雙方是唐朝劍南道與吐蕃帝國。貞元十七年（801）起，吐蕃一面在西北進攻鹽州、麟州，一面由內大相兼東鄙五道節度兵馬都統群牧大使論莽熱坐鎮川西方向，把維州、松州、昆明等城邑與周邊部落羈縻在吐蕃版圖之內。唐朝一方由唐德宗下詔，著劍南西川節度使韋皋率軍主動出擊；韋皋麾下設有鎮靜軍、威戎軍、鎮南軍等軍鎮，並與維州、保州、霸州、松州、雅州、黎州、巂州、邛州等州鎮的兵馬使、刺史、經略使分道出擊，同時徵用南詔兵與吐蕃降附的羌、戎、党項諸部落充當嚮導與前鋒。吐蕃軍隊以部落兵為骨幹，分為本號兵與各道節度兵，主帥多由大相、都統一級的蕃地貴族充任，兵法嚴整，前排死戰而後排跟進，絕不後退。整體而言，唐朝想以多路進攻的縱深打擊換取西線的喘息，吐蕃則想在守住川西要隘的同時，維持對唐西北與西南的雙向壓力。
countriesEn: This war was a decisive engagement on the western frontier between the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan Empire, fought between the Jiannan circuit of Tang China and the Tibetan state. From 801, the seventh year of the Zhenyuan era, Tibet pressed on Salt Prefecture and Lin Prefecture in the northwest while the internal minister Lun Mangre, who concurrently held the titles of Commander of the Five Eastern Circuits, Commissioner of the Army and Horses, and Grand Master of the Herds, sat over the Sichuan direction and held Weizhou, Songzhou, Kunming and the surrounding tribes in the Tibetan orbit. On the Tang side, Emperor Dezong of Tang issued the order to advance, and the Circuit Commissioner of Xichuan in Jiannan, Wei Gao, led the campaign. Under him stood the Zhenjing Army, the Weirong Army and the Zhennan Army, together with the Army Commissioners, prefects and Frontier Commissioners of Weizhou, Baozhou, Bazhou, Songzhou, Yazhou, Lizhou, Yizhou and Qiongzhou, each of them taking a separate line of advance; troops from Nanzhao and Tibetan-submitted Qiang, Rong and Tangxiang tribal contingents were also recruited as guides and foremen. The Tibetan armies were built around tribal levies, divided into the central guard and the circuit armies, and normally commanded by nobles of the Tibetan plateau holding the ranks of great minister or commander-in-chief. Their drill was strict: the front rank fought to the death and the rear ranks followed on, never breaking. In short, the Tang wanted a deep, multi-axis offensive in exchange for breathing space on the western front, while Tibet sought to hold its passes in western Sichuan while sustaining simultaneous pressure on Tang's northwest and southwest.
people: 此役的唐方主帥是劍南西川節度使韋皋。他自貞元初年鎮蜀，經營川西十餘年，招撫羌戎諸部，收復被吐蕃控制的州縣，是德宗朝最倚重的邊將之一；戰略由他一手定奪，事前偵知吐蕃援軍南下，立刻選地設伏，事後論功行賞、追認兵將。吐蕃方面，率十萬援軍者是內大相論莽熱，此人在吐蕃位同宰相，兼領東鄙五道節度兵馬都統群牧大使，掌東方邊防兵柄；802 年正月中伏被擒，唐廷未加刑辱，禮遇遣還，吐蕃亦未因此斷絕往來。基層將領包括鎮靜軍兵馬使陳洎、威戎軍使崔堯臣、維州保州兩州兵馬使仇昱、保州霸州兩州刺史董振、北路兵馬使邢玼、都將高倜與王英俊、東路兵馬使元膺、邛州鎮南軍使御史大夫韋良金、雅州經略使路惟明、黎州經略使王有道、巂州經略使陳孝陽等人，九路大軍各由一名主將率領，分別承擔穿插、進逼與攻取城邑的任務；各路另綁三部落主趙日進、郝全信等率部眾助戰。與唐軍南北呼應的是南詔王異牟尋，異牟尋出兵配合對維州與昆明方向的攻擊。背景人物則有曾在貞元年間以維州刺史身份降蕃的李燧，以及同期在河西收復州郡的節度使張議潮，正是李燧失州與張議潮的節制，使川西與西北兩線得以互相牽制。
peopleEn: The Tang commander in this war was Wei Gao, Circuit Commissioner of Xichuan in Jiannan. Since the opening years of the Zhenyuan era he had governed Shu and spent more than a decade in western Sichuan, winning over the Qiang and Rong tribes and recovering prefectures and counties held by Tibet, and he was among the frontier generals on whom Dezong relied most heavily. The strategy was his alone: he learned in advance that the Tibetan relief army was moving south, chose the ground for the ambush at once, and afterwards ranked the officers and confirmed the awards. On the Tibetan side the ten thousand-strong relief army was led by Lun Mangre, an internal minister who ranked like a chancellor of Tibet and concurrently held the office of Commander of the Five Eastern Circuits, Commissioner of the Army and Horses, and Grand Master of the Herds, in charge of the eastern defensive commands. When he was captured in the ambush of the first month of 802 the Tang court neither punished nor humiliated him but sent him home with courtesy, and Tibet did not break off contacts over the episode. The subordinate commanders included Chen Ji, Army Commissioner of the Zhenjing Army; Cui Yaochen, Commissioner of the Weirong Army; Qiu Yu, Army Commissioner of Weizhou and Baozhou; Dong Zhen, Prefect of Baozhou and Bazhou; Xing Cai, Commissioner of the Northern Route; the commanders Gao Ti and Wang Yingjun; Yuan Ying, Commissioner of the Eastern Route; Wei Liangjin, Army Commissioner of Zhennan at Qiongzhou and Censor-in-Chief; Lu Weiming, Frontier Commissioner of Yazhou; Wang Youdao, Frontier Commissioner of Lizhou; and Chen Xiaoyang, Frontier Commissioner of Yizhou. Each of the nine columns of the army was led by one of these officers and was given a separate task, ranging from infiltration to the close approach on the city to the actual storming of the fortified places, and several columns were reinforced by tribal leaders such as Zhao Rijin and Hao Quanxin with their own followers. Operating in concert with the Tang was the king of Nanzhao, Yimouxun, who sent troops to support the attacks against Weizhou and Kunming. Among the background figures are Li Sui, who as prefect of Weizhou surrendered the city to Tibet during the Zhenyuan era, and Zhang Yichao, who at the same time was recovering prefectures and counties in Hexi; it was Li Sui's loss of his city and Zhang Yichao's containment of Tibet in the northwest that made the two lines of the front able to check one another.
kits: 卡面的投石機即古典扭力投石機（onager），以絞盤把人力轉存為機身扭力，發射時將石彈拋向城壘，是羅馬時期攻城戰的標準器械，卡面標其為前250年前後的形制。唐朝在川西並未原樣使用這具羅馬機器，而是採用同一力學原理的中式拋石器械，即砲車、投石車：以木為架，或置於車上或架於木構台座，長臂一端設兜裝石，臂下繫長拉索，或加配重，發射時眾人猛拉索臂，將石彈拋出。唐軍攻城器械除拋石機外，尚有撞車、雲梯、巢車、拒馬、陷馬坑與版築工事，出兵時器械與糧草同運。吐蕃一方以城頭擲石、礮石與弓弩應對，居高臨下壓制唐軍的攻擊隊形，並以石壘、木柵與壕塹遲滯唐軍接近。801 年八月至十二月的九路進攻中，拋石機是對付維州、保州、松州、昆明諸城城牆的主要手段；802 年正月的決戰轉為峽谷中的設伏，韋皋仍把砲車配置在險要地帶兩側高處，用石彈打擊被引入谷道的密集隊列、封鎖退路。除攻城器械外，兩軍骨幹裝備差異更大：唐軍以步卒、弩手、長槍手為主，騎兵為輔，大量使用弩機與長槍；吐蕃兵以騎兵為主，兵長槍而不長於弓箭，近身格鬥則佩劍，遠程壓制能力弱於唐軍的弩，攻城器械亦相對簡陋。
kitsEn: The machine on the card face is the classical traction trebuchet, the onager, which stored human muscle power as torsion in the frame through a windlass and threw a stone bolt at the enemy wall; it was the standard siege engine of Roman warfare, and the card dates its form to roughly 250 BC. When the Tang fought in western Sichuan they did not copy the Roman machine literally but used the Chinese siege engine of the same mechanical principle, the pao-che or stone-thrower: a wooden frame, set either on a wheeled carriage or on a timber platform, with a long arm carrying a sling or cup at one end and long ropes or a counterweight below it, so that a crew hauling the ropes threw the stone out. Besides the stone-thrower the Tang siege train included rammers, scaling ladders, tower carts, cheval-de-frise, horse-pits and earthworks, and the engines travelled with the baggage. Tibet answered from the walls with thrown stones, stone bombs and crossbow fire, shooting down at the attacking formations and delaying the approach behind stone banks, wooden palisades and ditches. In the nine-column offensive between the eighth and the twelfth month of 801 the stone-thrower was the main instrument used against the walls of Weizhou, Baozhou, Songzhou and Kunming. In the first month of 802 the battle turned into an ambush in a gorge, and Wei Gao still posted the engines on the heights on both flanks of the defile, using their stones to break up the dense columns drawn into the valley and to seal the line of retreat. Beyond the siege engines the two armies differed sharply in their main equipment: the Tang fielded foot soldiers, crossbowmen and spearmen with cavalry in support and used the crossbow and the long spear in quantity, whereas the Tibetans were cavalry above all, armed with long spears rather than bows, fighting hand-to-hand with swords, and were markedly weaker in long-range pressure than the Tang crossbows; their own siege equipment was correspondingly crude.
tactics: 這場戰爭由兩種截然不同的打法拼成。第一段是 801 年的多路縱深進攻，韋皋把步騎兵二萬分為九路，各路指定主將與出擊路線：陳洎出三奇路，崔堯臣出龍溪石門路南，仇昱與董振進逼維州城中，邢玼與董懷愕攻棲雞與老翁城，高倜與王英俊進逼故松州，元膺與郝宗分兵八千出雅州、邛州、黎州、巂州一線，韋良金發兵續進，路惟明與趙日進攻偏松，王有道與郝全信越大渡河深入蕃境，陳孝陽與何大海、韋義攻昆明與諸濟城。多路同時進擊的用意，是把吐蕃在川西有限的守軍與援兵拆散到不同方向，使任何一路都難以集中兵力應付；對城邑則靠砲車、撞車與雲梯連續施壓，逼吐蕃把兵力和糧水壓縮在城內，迫其向大本營求援。第二段是 802 年正月的設伏決戰：論莽熱率十萬援軍南下解維州、昆明之圍，韋皋得悉後以西川兵萬餘預先佔據援軍必經的險要地帶，該處為岷江上游峽谷，道路狹窄，吐蕃騎兵只能縱列行進，無法展開衝鋒。韋皋先以精騎出挑戰，誘使吐蕃追殺，隊伍被拉成單縱隊拖入峽谷，再由兩側伏兵合擊，截斷其首尾連絡；配置在高處的砲車同時發射石彈，打擊縱深擁塞的密集隊形，騎兵在狹道中失去衝鋒空間，人馬踐踏，陣腳遂崩。吐蕃軍法要求前排死戰、後排跟進，本可在平曠處發揮的人海優勢，在隘路之中反而成了累贅。
tacticsEn: This war was built out of two entirely different kinds of fighting. The first phase was the multi-axis deep offensive of 801, in which Wei Gao divided his twenty thousand foot and horse into nine columns, each with its own commander and its own line of march: Chen Ji took the Sanqi road, Cui Yaochen the southern route through Longxi and Shimen, Qiu Yu and Dong Zhen closed in on the city of Weizhou, Xing Cai and Dong Huai'e attacked Qiji and Laoweng city, Gao Ti and Wang Yingjun pressed the old Songzhou, Yuan Ying and Hao Zong sent eight thousand men out along the line of Yazhou, Qiongzhou, Lizhou and Yizhou, Wei Liangjin followed them up, Lu Weiming with Zhao Rijin attacked Piensong, Wang Youdao with Hao Quanxin crossed the Dadu River deep into Tibetan territory, and Chen Xiaoyang with He Dahai and Wei Yi struck Kunming and Zhuji. The point of striking along so many lines at once was to split the limited Tibetan garrisons and reinforcements in western Sichuan across different directions, so that no single column of the Tang could be met by a concentrated force; against the fortified towns the pressure was applied by stone-throwers, rammers and scaling ladders in turn, compressing the Tibetan soldiers and their grain and water inside the walls and forcing the appeal for help to the great camp. The second phase was the ambush of the first month of 802: Lun Mangre led a relief army of a hundred thousand south to lift the siege of Weizhou and Kunming, and once Wei Gao had the news he stationed more than ten thousand Xichuan troops in advance on the ground the relieving army must cross, a defile in the upper Min River gorge where the road was so narrow that the Tibetan horse could only advance in column and had no room to charge. Wei Gao first sent picked cavalry out to give battle and tempt the Tibetans into the pursuit, so that their column was drawn out and dragged into the gorge, and then the ambush on both flanks struck together and cut their head from their tail; the engines posted on the heights loosed their stones into the crowded, congested ranks, and with no room to charge in the narrow track the cavalry were trampled underfoot and the formation collapsed. Tibetan drill required the front rank to fight to the death and the rear ranks to follow on; the advantage of mass that would have told in open ground became a liability in the defile.
data: 可用的數字主要來自《資治通鑑》卷二百三十六與唐史列傳，須留意唐代史書習於誇大，數字宜作概數看。時間線上，吐蕃攻鹽州在貞元十七年七月十八日，七月二十九日陷麟州，殺刺史郭鋒、毀城郭；韋皋受命出擊自 801 年七月末起，至 802 年正月決戰，前後約半年。各路兵力有明確記載：陳洎一萬，崔堯臣一千，仇昱與董振二千，邢玼與董懷愕四千，高倜與王英俊二千，元膺與郝宗八千，韋良金一千三百，路惟明與趙日進三千，王有道與郝全信二千，陳孝陽與何大海、韋義四千，合計約二萬八千，與分兵二萬的總數大致相合。戰果方面，史載八月至十二月之間擊潰吐蕃軍十六萬，攻取城池七座、軍鎮五座，焚毀堡壘一百五十個，斬首萬餘人，俘六千餘人，受降三千餘戶。802 年正月，論莽熱率兵十萬赴援，韋皋以萬餘人設伏，一戰而擒論莽熱，吐蕃援軍死傷大半。地形與距離方面，維州治薛城，在今四川理縣東北，松州治嘉誠在今松潘，昆明在今鹽源，三處自東南向西北排列於岷江與大渡河上游的高山河谷，驛路狹窄，車載砲車與糧秣多賴人力畜力搬運。投石機的性能，唐人兵書所載砲車可拋數十斤至百餘斤之石，所中城壁為之潰，射程至數百步，發射需眾人拉索，屬一發一歇的攻具，而非可以連續射擊的軍械。
dataEn: The usable figures come chiefly from the Zizhi Tongjian, juan 236, and the Tang dynastic histories, and it must be remembered that Tang historians were given to exaggeration, so the numbers should be read as approximations. On the chronology, Tibet attacked Salt Prefecture on the eighteenth day of the seventh month of the seventeenth year of Zhenyuan and took Lin Prefecture on the twenty-ninth, killing the prefect Guo Feng and destroying the walls; Wei Gao's offensive was ordered from the end of the seventh month of 801 and the decisive action came in the first month of 802, a matter of some six months. The strength of each column is recorded: ten thousand under Chen Ji, one thousand under Cui Yaochen, two thousand under Qiu Yu and Dong Zhen, four thousand under Xing Cai and Dong Huai'e, two thousand under Gao Ti and Wang Yingjun, eight thousand under Yuan Ying and Hao Zong, thirteen hundred under Wei Liangjin, three thousand under Lu Weiming and Zhao Rijin, two thousand under Wang Youdao and Hao Quanxin, and four thousand under Chen Xiaoyang, He Dahai and Wei Yi, totalling roughly twenty-eight thousand, which matches the stated overall figure of twenty thousand closely enough. As to results, the histories record that between the eighth and the twelfth month the Tang routed a Tibetan force numbered at one hundred and sixty thousand, took seven cities and five military towns, burned a hundred and fifty forts, cut down more than ten thousand men, took over six thousand prisoners and accepted more than three thousand households in submission. In the first month of 802 Lun Mangre led a hundred thousand to the relief, Wei Gao ambushed them with more than ten thousand men, and the minister was taken alive in a single action while the greater part of the relief army was killed or scattered. As to terrain and distance, Weizhou had its seat at Xuecheng, to the north-east of present-day Lixian in Sichuan, Songzhou at Jiacheng in today's Songpan and Kunming at present-day Yanyuan, the three places running from south-east to north-west along the upper gorges of the Min and Dadu rivers; the post roads were narrow and the engines and baggage had to be moved largely by human and animal labour. For the stone-thrower, the Tang military books record that the pao-che could throw a stone of several tens to more than a hundred catties, shattering the wall it struck, at a range of several hundred paces, and that firing needed a crew hauling the ropes, so that it was an engine that shot and then waited rather than a weapon capable of continuous fire.
cause: 起戰有遠因也有近因。遠因是安史之亂以後唐朝邊防空虛，吐蕃趁勢席捲河西、青海與川西，貞元十一年（795）維州陷蕃，此後松州、保州一帶也淪入其手，川西門戶洞開，唐朝在岷江上游失去立足之地。近因是 801 年吐蕃重兵北上，攻陷鹽州、麟州，殺刺史郭鋒，直接威脅西北邊防與京畿側翼；若川西同時鬆動，唐在西北與西南便要兩面受敵。德宗詔令韋皋由東南線縱深出擊，用以分散吐蕃兵力、減輕西北壓力，此即戰役的直接目的。韋皋經營川西多年，招撫羌戎部落、熟悉蕃情，具備深入作戰的條件；南詔王異牟尋亦因與吐蕃有邊界糾葛而願意配合，使唐軍得以在多方向同時施壓。朝廷內部對吐蕃的策略並不一致，陸贄等人主張審度形勢、不以土地為累，傾向以威懾與羈縻換取邊境安寧，韋皋則以實戰收復失地，這一分歧在邊疆被執行成了一場戰役。相對地，吐蕃自 795 年取維州之後，一直靠當地守軍與羈縻部落維持對唐的邊緣壓力；維州卡在唐、吐蕃與南詔三方之間，位置敏感，一旦唐軍集結反攻，維州與昆明必然首當其衝，故援軍北下並非偶然。
causeEn: The war had both a distant and an immediate cause. The distant cause is the collapse of Tang's frontier defences after the An Lushan rebellion, which let the Tibetan Empire sweep over Hexi, Qinghai and western Sichuan; Weizhou fell to Tibet in 795, and Songzhou and Baozhou followed, so that the western gate of Sichuan stood open and the Tang lost its footing on the upper Min River. The immediate cause was the Tibetan drive north in 801, the taking of Salt and Lin prefectures and the killing of the prefect Guo Feng, which threatened the north-western defences and the flank of the capital region; had western Sichuan slackened at the same time, the Tang would have been pressed from two directions. The decree instructing Wei Gao to strike deep along the south-eastern line was meant to divide the Tibetan forces and relieve the pressure in the north-west, and that was the direct purpose of the campaign. Wei Gao had governed western Sichuan for years, won over the Qiang and Rong tribes and knew the Tibetan frontier, so he had the conditions for a deep operation; and the king of Nanzhao, Yimouxun, was willing to act in concert because of his own border friction with Tibet, which allowed the Tang to apply pressure along several axes at once. Policy towards Tibet was not uniform at court: figures such as Lu Zhi argued for weighing the situation and not being burdened by territory, favouring deterrence and the appeasement of tribes in exchange for peace on the border, while Wei Gao chose to recover the lost ground by force; that disagreement was carried out on the frontier as a battle. On the other side, since taking Weizhou in 795 Tibet had kept up its pressure on the Tang border by means of the local garrison and the dependent tribes; Weizhou lay wedged between Tang, Tibet and Nanzhao in a sensitive position, and once the Tang concentrated for a counter-offensive, Weizhou and Kunming were inevitably the first to bear the blow, so the relief army's move south was no accident.
impact: 此役的結果是唐軍收復維州，並在一段時間內維持住松州、維州一線的屏障，川西首府成都從此不必再靠模糊的羈縻關係換取安寧；吐蕃則失去在岷江上游最靠近成都的一枚楔子，被迫退守青海方向，西北的壓力為張議潮在河西收復州郡留出了空間，張議潮其後在 806 年前後恢復河西十一州，兩線的呼應由此成形。對吐蕃內部而言，十萬大軍在峽谷覆沒、大相被俘，是唐朝多年來最為聲張的一次邊疆勝利，吐蕃朝野震動，東鄙五道的邊防體系需要重整，大相與贊普之間的權力張力亦隨之上升；論莽熱回到蕃地後仍居高位，但吐蕃此後在川西轉取守勢，戰略重心移向青海與河西。另一方面，這場勝利並未改變雙方實力的基本格局：唐軍深入蕃境後即行回縮，未能乘勢擴張；韋皋本人的壽命也隨之走到盡頭，貞元年間整備起來的川西邊軍在他死後漸漸分散。戰略上，此役確立了唐軍在川西峽谷地帶以設伏破敵、以攻城器械先取城寨的成熟套路，被後世西南邊防將領視為範例；政治上，它延後而非解決了唐蕃衝突，二十年後的長慶會盟才以界碑的形式把這條線固定下來，說明貞元末年的勝利只是延遲了和談，並沒有終止戰爭。
impactEn: The outcome of the war was that the Tang recovered Weizhou and for a time held the line of Songzhou and Weizhou, so that the western Sichuan capital of Chengdu no longer had to buy its security with vague dependent relationships. Tibet lost the wedge it had driven furthest toward Chengdu on the upper Min River and was pushed back toward Qinghai; the pressure in the north-west left Zhang Yichao room to recover prefectures and counties in Hexi, and Zhang was able to restore the eleven Hexi prefectures around 806, so that the two fronts began to work together. Inside Tibet, the destruction of a hundred thousand men in a gorge and the capture of a great minister made this the most conspicuous Tibetan defeat the Tang had scored in years; the court was shaken, the defensive system of the five eastern circuits had to be rebuilt, and the tension between the great ministers and the king rose with it. Lun Mangre returned to his own country and kept his high position, but Tibet thereafter took a defensive posture in western Sichuan and shifted its strategic weight towards Qinghai and Hexi. At the same time the victory did not alter the basic balance of strength: the Tang withdrew after penetrating Tibetan ground instead of pressing the advantage, and Wei Gao's own life ran out, the western Sichuan frontier force he had trained during the Zhenyuan years gradually dispersing after his death. In tactical terms the campaign established a mature Tang pattern for western Sichuan, defeating the enemy by ambush in the gorges after taking the fortified towns with siege engines, and later commanders on that frontier treated it as a model. In political terms it postponed rather than settled the Tang-Tibetan conflict; it took the Changqing conference twenty years later to fix this line with boundary markers, which shows that the victories of the late Zhenyuan years only delayed the negotiations and did not end the war.
result: 802 年正月的結局相當明確：吐蕃援軍在維州薛城一帶的山峽中被唐軍誘入伏地，論莽熱被生擒，隨軍騎兵與步卒死傷大半，十萬大軍不戰自潰，維州與昆明的圍困隨之解除，吐蕃在川西的攻勢為之一挫。唐軍乘勢追擊，韋皋於同年再向昆明方向施壓，吐蕃守軍收攏殘部退保，川西戰局重回唐軍掌握。此役之後，唐朝據維州、松州等城，控制岷江與大渡河上游的關隘，松潘一帶的高原通道重新成為唐營的進攻基地；吐蕃則退守青海，以拉薩為中心重新部署兵賦，改以遊騎騷擾與局部攻擊為主，雙方在川西的拉鋸轉為長期的邊境消耗。史載此役斬獲、俘虜與降戶的數目顯然帶有唐代史書的誇飾，論者多以為實際戰果當遠小於此；但論莽熱被俘、援軍覆沒、維州重歸唐室三事，於正史與編年史中前後互證，可信度較高。韋皋於貞元年間病卒，朝廷追贈官爵，其經營川西的成果在唐蕃和議達成之前得以延續。就全局而言，這是一場有限而乾淨的勝利：唐以主動出擊換回戰略主動，卻沒有把優勢轉化為疆域的擴張，二十年後的長慶會盟標誌著雙方最終以劃界收場。
resultEn: The outcome of the first month of 802 is clear enough: the Tibetan relief army was drawn into the trap in the gorges around Xuecheng in Weizhou, Lun Mangre was taken alive, a large part of the horse and foot with him was killed or scattered, and the army of a hundred thousand broke up without a further general action, relieving the pressure on Weizhou and Kunming and checking the Tibetan offensive in western Sichuan for the time being. The Tang followed up, and in the same year Wei Gao pressed again in the direction of Kunming, the Tibetan defenders gathering what was left and falling back, so that the command of the field in western Sichuan returned to the Tang. After the war the Tang held the cities of Weizhou and Songzhou and controlled the passes of the upper Min and Dadu rivers, and the plateau route through Songpan became once more a base for Tang operations; Tibet withdrew to Qinghai, redeployed its fiscal and military resources around its centre, and turned to harassment by mounted patrols and local attacks, so that the contest in western Sichuan became a long attritional drain along the border. The figures recorded for the kills, prisoners and surrendered households in this campaign clearly carry the exaggeration of Tang historiography, and most readers hold that the real results were far smaller; but three things, the capture of Lun Mangre, the destruction of the relief army and the return of Weizhou to the Tang, corroborate one another in the official histories and the annals and can be relied upon with more confidence. Wei Gao died of illness during the Zhenyuan years and the court granted him posthumous rank and offices, and the work he had done in western Sichuan was carried on until the Tang and Tibet came to terms. In overall terms this was a limited but clean victory: the Tang bought back the initiative by attacking first, yet converted no advantage into an extension of territory, and the Changqing conference twenty years later marked the two sides' final settlement by a drawn line.
